chapters.title: Along the rivers
chapters.text: River paths, vineyards and canals carry the route east through France.

chapters.title: Towards the mountains
chapters.text: Through southern Germany to Munich, then long days towards the Austrian mountains.

chapters.title: Over the Tauern
chapters.text: Sharp climbs, streams and narrow ridges, then a descent down empty ski slopes after dark.

chapters.title: Out onto the plains
chapters.text: Rain and wooded climbs give way to canal paths, flat farmland and the Croatian plain.

chapters.title: The road to Belgrade
chapters.text: River paths and muddy ground lead to Belgrade, with monuments photographed along the way.

chapters.title: The last roads
chapters.text: Across the Bulgarian border, over the final hills and into Sofia.

moments.title: Twenty kilometres beside the river
moments.text: The route followed the river for about twenty kilometres, then continued through Château-Thierry onto wooded paths.
moments.position: Shown within the recorded day; the photograph has no GPS position.

moments.title: Between the cliff faces
moments.text: Cliff faces flanked the path, with blue flies moving between them. Witchi Tai To played on this section.
moments.position: Shown within the recorded day; the photograph has no GPS position.

moments.title: The mountains close in
moments.text: A sharp climb and a small waterfall marked the start of Austria, with mountains surrounding the road.
moments.position: Shown within the recorded day; the photograph has no GPS position.

moments.title: Across the high ridges
moments.text: Streams, scrambles and narrow ridges crossed the Tauern at about 2,500 metres. The descent continued down empty ski slopes after dark.
moments.position: The crossing is attached to day 30; it does not identify a particular summit.

moments.title: A wooded climb after dark
moments.text: More than fifty kilometres through drizzle, waterlogged paths and fog ended with a steep wooded climb after dark.
moments.position: Shown within the recorded day; the photograph has no GPS position.

moments.title: Across the flat farmland
moments.text: Trains bridged unsafe main-road sections before a walk across flat farmland to Osijek. The gaps in the recordings remain visible on the map.
moments.evidence: Route note dated 5 November, associated with day 42
moments.position: Shown within the recorded day; the photograph has no GPS position.

moments.title: An aircraft above the road
moments.text: An aircraft mounted above a plinth appears in the photographs from the approach to Belgrade.
moments.position: Photo-day marker. The exact monument location has not been confirmed.

moments.title: The monument in the park
moments.text: A pale obelisk topped by a dark flame-shaped sculpture stands in the park, photographed on the day the route reached Belgrade.
moments.position: Photo-day marker. The exact monument location has not been confirmed.

moments.title: One last road to Sofia
moments.text: The border crossing left Sofia one day away. The final roads through the Bulgarian hills brought the Paris-to-Sofia trek to its end.
moments.position: Shown within the recorded day; the photograph has no GPS position.
